'''''Hatch''''' was a civilian [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] it was part of heavy [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] traffic between [[Navigation buoy/Legends|Navigation buoys]] [[B-52]] and [[B-53]]. The transport was inspected by a single [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] to find equipment inside its cargo. The transport soon jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]].
